description:
Affected extension: dynamic-tools.ex
Upstream: pi.registerTool() can be called at any time — including inside session_start or command handlers — and the new tool is immediately available for the session.
Current workaround: echo_session is registered at init rather than in session_start (works only because the tool is always desired). The /add-echo-tool command tracks names in a registry Agent for dedup and state inspection but cannot actually add a new tool to the live session — the Extension struct is immutable after build_extension/2.
What's needed: a post-init tool registration path. Options:
  (a) Agent/GenServer-backed mutable extension: add_tool/2 mutates a live state process.
  (b) A runtime registration callback (like append_entry) that routes the new tool spec to AgentSession/Interactive.
The callback approach (b) is lower overhead and consistent with other API fn fields.
Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/dynamic-tools.ts (pi.registerTool in session_start)
title: Dynamic tool registration after init — extensions immutable after build_extension/2
